title: EMF vs Terminal Voltage
text: EMF (ε) is the total energy per coulomb the battery can supply. Terminal voltage (V) is what's available across the external circuit. Some energy is 'lost' in the internal resistance.

title: The Circuit Equation
text: EMF = voltage across external circuit + voltage across internal resistance. So ε = IR + Ir = I(R + r).

title: Terminal Voltage
text: Terminal voltage V = ε - Ir. When no current flows (open circuit), V = ε. When current flows, V < ε due to internal voltage drop.
